BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

6. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   B. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   D. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   B. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   B. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

10. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   B. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   D. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   B. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   D. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
